landingEyebrow: A calmer place for your credentials
landingTitle: Your passwords, all in one place.
landingBody: A personal vault for the details you need every day, with privacy and clarity at its heart.
faqA1: Yes. Sealero is zero-knowledge: your vault is encrypted on your device before it ever leaves it. The server stores ciphertext only and can never read your passwords, notes, or TOTP secrets.
faqQ2: What happens if I forget my master password?
faqA2: Your master password never leaves your device and cannot be recovered by us. Use the 24-word recovery key you backed up at registration to regain access. Without it, the vault cannot be opened.
faqA3: The server is open source (AGPLv3) and free to self-host, with unlimited items and devices. The Pro plan covers the official hosted cloud, so you do not have to run a server yourself.
faqA4: Web is available now, with an Android app in development. Your vault syncs across devices when you use the official cloud or your own server.
faqQ5: Is the server code open source?
faqA5: Yes. The server is published under AGPLv3 on GitHub, so anyone can read, audit, and self-host it. The Android app stays closed source.
aiCallTitle: Ask your AI for a password
aiCallDescription: Ask once, get your password. No copy-paste.
aiCallPoint1Body: OAuth 2.1 + MCP, straight into your vault.
aiCallPoint2Body: One tap in the web UI. Good for 5 minutes, single use.
aiCallPoint3Body: The server only returns ciphertext. Decryption happens on your side.

termsS1Body: Sealero (the “Service”) is a zero-knowledge password manager operated by Werkero, a personal studio brand, including the web app, server, API, and MCP connection. These Terms cover the official cloud service; the open-source server (AGPLv3) may be self-hosted, and self-hosted instances are the responsibility of their own operator and are not covered by these Terms. By registering for or using the Service, you accept these Terms.
termsS2Body: “Werkero” means the personal studio brand; “Vault” means the passwords, notes, and secret entries you store in encrypted form; “Master Password” means the password used only on your device to decrypt your vault, which is never uploaded; “Recovery Key” means the 24 words generated at registration to restore your vault if you forget your Master Password; “Encrypted Data” means your encrypted vault contents and metadata; “Account” means the Sealero account you register with an email address; “Official Cloud” means the hosted service operated by Werkero; “Self-Hosted Instance” means a server deployed by someone else under the AGPLv3; “Connected AI” means an AI assistant connected to your vault over MCP.
termsS3Body: Subject to these Terms, we grant you a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the Service. You must not copy, modify, or reverse-engineer the Service, resell or sublicense it, bypass usage limits, or break the isolation between accounts. You are responsible for the actions of any Connected AI: every time it fetches a password, you must confirm once in the web app, and each confirmation is valid once; you bear the consequences and any costs of what it does. Keep your login password, Master Password, and Recovery Key safe: the Master Password and Recovery Key exist only with you, and if you lose them we cannot recover them — you will permanently lose access to your vault. On the Official Cloud each user is limited to 100 MB in total and 1 MB per item, with no limit on the number of items or devices. We may suspend or restrict your Account if you violate this section.
termsS4Body: You must not use the Service to mine cryptocurrency or farm resources, to scan, probe, or attack other systems, to phish or steal credentials, to send spam or manipulate platforms, to abuse networks, or to store or distribute unlawful or harmful content. We monitor for abnormal use; if we find a violation, we may throttle, suspend, close ports, or disable your Account. Mining, scanning, phishing, fraud, and child sexual abuse material may be actioned immediately without prior notice; in other cases we will try to contact you first. If you believe an action was wrong, you may appeal by contacting us through the Werkero website.
termsS5Body: You are responsible for the actions of everyone who uses your Account and for any Connected AI you authorize. You manage your own software and devices and are responsible for the third-party services you use, including any cloud backup you enable (Google Drive, Dropbox, or WebDAV) — backup files live in your own cloud drive and are governed by that provider's terms. You are responsible for keeping your own recovery copies: keep your Recovery Key safe and export an encrypted backup regularly.
termsS6Body: The Service is currently offered free of charge, and no paid plans are offered yet. If paid plans are introduced, we will show the price and billing terms before you subscribe and update these Terms accordingly; existing subscribers will be notified of price changes in advance. You are responsible for any applicable taxes.
termsS7Body: The platform, software, trademarks, and other intellectual property of the Service belong to Werkero. Your vault data belongs to you; you grant us the limited license needed to provide the Service. We may freely use any feedback or suggestions you send us, without obligation.
termsS8Body: Your vault data is confidential: the server only ever sees ciphertext and cannot read your passwords or notes. We take reasonable security measures to protect it, as described in the Privacy Policy. The Official Cloud uses the following sub-processors: Vercel (hosting), Neon (database), and Resend (email delivery). Official Cloud data is stored in the United States. When service ends, you can export your data; deleting your Account immediately and permanently deletes your vault and account data (except audit and login records, see the Privacy Policy). If a security incident occurs, we will notify affected users as required by law. Do not store protected health information in the Service without a signed business associate agreement.
termsS9Body: The Service is provided “as is”, without warranties of any kind, express or implied. To the maximum extent permitted by law, our total liability is limited to the fees you actually paid for the Service in the past 12 months, and we are not liable for any indirect loss, loss of profit, or loss of data. We are not liable for loss of access to your vault caused by forgetting your Master Password or Recovery Key.
termsS10Body: You may close your Account and stop using the Service at any time by deleting your Account in the app. If you materially breach these Terms, we will give you 30 days to remedy it; if you do not, or if you seriously violate them again, we may terminate the Service immediately. Clauses on data, intellectual property, and limitation of liability survive termination.

We are not liable for service interruptions caused by force majeure. For questions, contact us through the Werkero website (https://werkero.vercel.app).
privacyS1Body: This Policy covers Sealero's website, web app, API, and MCP connection, and is issued by Werkero, a personal studio brand (“we”). For the Official Cloud, we are the controller of your account information; your vault contents belong to you, and we only store and sync them in encrypted form — we cannot read them in plaintext, so some controller obligations do not apply to them. Self-hosted instances send us nothing. The Official Cloud runs in the United States.
privacyS2Body: Registration: your email address, an Argon2id hash of your login password, and your email verification status. Encrypted data: ciphertext and nonces of vault items, domain HMACs used for search, and version numbers. Devices: device name, type, and public key. Login records: login time, IP address, device and browser information, and whether the attempt succeeded or failed and why. Audit records: account actions and AI fetch records, with IP addresses. Consent records: the privacy-policy version, the time of consent, and the IP address. Communications: emails you send us. We offer no social login, so we receive no account information from third parties. Automatically collected data includes page-visit counts (Vercel Analytics, which only counts visits, uses no cookies, and never records vault contents) and server logs used for security and rate limiting. When an AI fetches a password over MCP, an audit record is created; cloud-backup credentials stay in your browser and are never sent to our servers.
privacyS3Body: We use the following sub-processors to provide the Service: Vercel (hosting), Neon (database), and Resend (email delivery), only within the scope needed to provide their service. We do not sell your personal data, and we do not use your vault data to train models (we cannot read it in any case). We may disclose information where required by law or to protect safety and rights. If the business is transferred, your data may transfer with it, and we will notify you in advance. With your consent, or to provide a feature you requested (such as a cloud backup you enabled), we share data as you direct. Aggregated, anonymized statistics contain no personal data.
privacyS4Body: You have the right to access, correct, and delete your personal data, to export your data (vault export), to restrict or object to processing, to withdraw consent, and to complain to a supervisory authority. Contact us through the Werkero website to exercise these rights; please state your request, and we will reply within 30 days after verifying your identity. You can unsubscribe from marketing emails at any time; service emails such as verification codes and password resets are required for your account to work and cannot be unsubscribed from. You can manage your account, credentials, and devices yourself in the app.
privacyS5Body: We use one necessary session cookie (__Host-sealero_refresh, HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, valid for 30 days) to keep you signed in; it contains no vault content. Preferences are stored in your browser's local storage. Analytics uses Vercel Analytics, which only counts page visits and uses no cookies. We use no advertising cookies and do not track you across sites.
privacyS6Body: Account information and encrypted vault data are kept while your account exists and deleted immediately when it is deleted. Deleted items keep a minimal tombstone for 30 days (item identifier and deletion time only, no content), after which only the minimal content-free record remains. Email verification codes expire after 15 to 30 minutes (30 minutes for password resets, 15 minutes for verification and deletion codes); MCP confirmations expire after 5 minutes; login sessions last at most 30 days, with an absolute session limit of 90 days. Login and audit records are kept without account identifiers after your account is deleted, for security purposes only. Cloud backups are your own files, with the latest 7 kept per destination, and you can delete them yourself. Support emails are kept only as long as needed to handle your request.
privacyS7Body: You can delete your account yourself in the app: after exporting an encrypted backup and confirming you have saved it, your account and vault are deleted immediately and permanently and cannot be restored. If you need help, contact us through the Werkero website: we will verify your identity, confirm receipt within 5 business days, and complete the deletion within 30 days (up to 90 days for complex cases), then email you to confirm. Deletion covers your account, vault, devices, and sessions; de-identified login and audit records are excepted.
privacyS8Body: Data is encrypted with TLS in transit and stored with AES-256-GCM; login passwords are hashed with Argon2id; the Master Password is used only on your device and never uploaded; each vault uses its own random key. Access follows least privilege, key actions are written to audit logs and reviewed regularly. If a data breach occurs, we will notify regulators within 72 hours where European users are affected, and notify affected users without undue delay.
privacyS9Body: The Service may link to third-party sites such as the GitHub repository and the Werkero website. Their privacy policies apply once you follow those links, and we are not responsible for their content.
privacyS10Body: The Service is not directed at children under 13 (under 16 in the European Economic Area). We do not knowingly collect children's personal data; if you believe we have, contact us through the Werkero website and we will delete it.
privacyS11Body: We may update this Policy; material changes will be notified 30 days in advance by email or in the app. Continued use of the Service means you accept the new Policy.
privacyS12Body: For users in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, and Switzerland, our legal bases for processing personal data are: performance of a contract (providing the Service), legitimate interests (keeping the Service secure and running), your consent (for example, marketing emails), and legal obligations. You have the right to complain to your local supervisory authority.
privacyS13Body: Official Cloud data is stored in the United States. When personal data is transferred outside the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, and Switzerland, we use appropriate safeguards such as the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs). For self-hosted instances, the operator decides where data is stored.
privacyS14Body: If you have any questions about this Policy, contact us through the Werkero website (https://werkero.vercel.app).
